title: 第17章 技惊四座下第18章 合约争论
content_zh:
;;
会议室内，一片议论声，所有老师脸上都有着好奇。
“20.1级。”
“这是考核到现在，第二个生命层次达到20级的吧。”有老师若有所思。
哪怕在武道本科里，刚进入大四的学生，生命层次能达到20级也属于少数，更别说武道大专里了。
“嗯，大三期末考核时候，倒是也有两个，都在第一批保送名单里。”
“叫方羽？”
“我查到了，他大三期末考核，生命层次是15.5级。”已经有老师开始查之前的考核成绩：“不到两个月，提升接近5级？”
“这么夸张？”
“他没觉醒星相，家里是富豪？”
“我怎么没印象？学校里，所有家里资产上亿的学生，我都是有印象的。”
“难道是技艺突破？”
“有可能，他之前技艺分数就很高，大概率是的。”
“是严老师班上的。”众多老师议论纷纷，都在猜测着，他们虽惊讶于方羽的爆发，但也不算太过吃惊。
毕竟，他们都是生命层次30多级的高级武者。
年复一年，见过数以万计的学生，在专升本考核中，时常就有爆发的，甚至有些极耀眼的武道天赋出现。
大器晚成者，从不止一人。
唯有严福，他心中还有一丝忐忑，更有很大期待：“身体技艺，一定要是入微大成……若真只是纯靠购买宝物，短期堆积的20级生命层次，没有觉醒虚空星相，可未必能入选保送名单。”
虚空星相、武道技艺、生命层次……正常情况下，有一项极度优秀，另外两项中等偏上，保送便问题不大了。
但若某一项缺失，则对另两项要求都会极高。

严福班上，今年还没出现能确保保送的学生。
时间流逝。
众多老师关注下，方羽以此完成了基础拳力检测、基础速度检测等等，尤其是拳力测试仪上显露‘2122公斤’，更是让严福心放下了一半。
前面的测试仪，是通过气血气息、生物磁场等多维度检测，是有出差错乃至作弊可能的。
所以，才要加上拳力检测、速度检测。
“技艺检测了。”
“是否入微大成。”所有老师都很关注这一点，这决定方羽能否稳拿一个保送名单，关乎到每一个人的利益。
很快。
方羽的技艺分数显示为‘120分’的满分，极限拳力测试仪上，也显露出‘3866公斤’的数字来。
办公室内再度响起议论声。
“果然！入微大成！”
“稳了！”
“严老师，恭喜。”
“恭喜。”所有老师都向严福发出了道贺，他们作为武道班主任，今年的绩效考核里最重要的三项，15级率、技艺入微率、专升本人数。
“哈哈，运气。”严福心情很好。
至少，今年的专升本人数不会挂零了。
content_en:
;;
There was a lot of discussion in the conference room, and all the teachers had curiosity on their faces.
"Level 20.1."
"This is the second life level that has reached level 20 since the assessment." A teacher said thoughtfully.
Even among martial arts undergraduates, there are only a handful of students who have just entered their senior year who can reach level 20, let alone martial arts junior colleges.
"Well, during the final assessment of the junior year, there were two of them, and they were both on the first batch of recommended candidates."
"Your name is Fang Yu?"
"I found out that in the final assessment of his junior year, his life level was level 15.5." Some teachers have already started to check the previous assessment results: "In less than two months, he has improved to nearly 5 levels?"
"So exaggerated?"
"He hasn't awakened his astrology, and his family is rich?"
"Why am I not impressed? I am impressed by all the students in the school whose families have assets worth hundreds of millions."
"Is it a technical breakthrough?"
"It's possible. His skill score was very high before. It's most likely yes."
"It's from Teacher Yan's class." Many teachers were talking and guessing. Although they were surprised by Fang Yu's outburst, they were not too surprised.
After all, they are all advanced warriors with a life level of more than 30 levels.
Year after year, I have seen tens of thousands of students, and in the examinations for junior college to undergraduate, there are often explosive and even some extremely dazzling martial arts talents.
There is never more than one late bloomer.
Only Yan Fu is still a little uneasy in his heart, and he has great expectations: "Physical skills must be mastered... If you really just rely on buying treasures, accumulating 20 life levels in a short period of time, and not awakening the void star, you may not be able to be selected for the recommended list."
Void astrology, martial arts skills, life level... Under normal circumstances, if one is extremely good and the other two are above average, then there is no big problem with a recommendation.
But if one is missing, the requirements for the other two will be extremely high.
In Yan Fu's class, there is no student who can guarantee admission this year.
Time passes.
With the attention of many teachers, Fang Yu completed the basic boxing strength test, basic speed test, etc. Especially when the boxing strength tester showed '2122 kg', Yan Fuxin was half relieved.
The previous tester uses multi-dimensional detection such as qi, blood, breath, and biological magnetic field, so there is a possibility of errors or even cheating.
Therefore, it is necessary to add punch strength detection and speed detection.
"Skills tested."
"Whether he can reach great success." All teachers are very concerned about this point, which determines whether Fang Yu can securely be on the recommended list, which is related to everyone's interests.
soon.
Fang Yu's skill score showed a full score of '120 points', and the ultimate boxing strength tester also showed a number of '3866 kilograms'.
Discussions resounded in the office again.
"Sure enough! A great success!"
"Stable!"
"Teacher Yan, congratulations."
"Congratulations." All the teachers congratulated Yan Fu. As martial arts class teachers, the three most important factors in this year's performance appraisal are the level 15 rate, the rate of mastering skills, and the number of junior college graduates.
"Haha, luck." Yan Fu was in a good mood.
At least, the number of junior college graduates this year will not drop to zero.
